click: a short clean click of a button being pressed
downlifter: a descending whoosh that fades out
a falling pitch sweep winding down
glitch: a digital glitch with stuttering noise
impact: a huge low thud for a movie trailer
a massive hit with a rumbling tail
logo_sting: a short musical logo with a ringing finish
a bright struck bell ringing out
notify: a single bell ding on a phone
pop: a popping sound like a bubble bursting
riser: a tension build-up getting louder and louder
a whooshing crescendo that swells to a climax
sub_drop: a low frequency boom that drops in pitch
swipe: fabric rustling in one quick swipe
swish: a light quick swoosh of a thrown object
tap: a light tap of a finger on a phone screen
typing_key: one key being pressed on a computer keyboard
a single keystroke on a mechanical keyboard
whoosh_big: a heavy swooping rush of air
a big slow swoosh in a movie trailer
whoosh_fast: a quick swoosh as something flies past
a short sharp swoosh of air

downlifter.note: empty: the licensed library has no downlifter, real or designed (no reversing or pitching of other sounds here: trim + fade only). Benchmark made downlifters on phrasings, AudioSet and artifacts only.

glitch.note: empty: no glitch material, real or designed, in the licensed library. Benchmark made glitches on phrasings, AudioSet and artifacts only.

impact.note: thin: the library has three cinematic hits (all three were the v1 impact forge refs); one is held out as bench, so v1 impact bench numbers are optimistic.

logo_sting.note: no real logo stings exist in the library (they are composed); the refs are the struck metal / glass rings a sting ends on: a tail-shape and tone reference only.

notify.note: struck bells / glass / kalimba (forge) and celesta / glass / triangle (bench), rings capped at 2 s with a 0.25 s fade; no designed UI dings in the library.

riser.note: thin: one designed trailer riser (forge); the bench is two real cymbal swells, no synth risers.

shimmer.note: kit shimmer_01 (bar chimes sweep) is bench: its author also recorded the celesta notify bench.

sub_drop.note: one designed source (a tom pitched down 24 semitones by its author), held out as bench; the forge has no sub-drop refs.

swipe.note: cloth only: the library has no paper slides.

whoosh_big.note: forge = three designed Mixkit whooshes; bench = real air / cape swoops.
